description.value:
The Hyūga clan's signature combat jutsu. With Byakugan active, you target a creature in your reach with a flurry of palm strikes targeting their chakra pathways.

You make 8 unarmed Strikes against a single creature; the first 4 take no multiple attack penalty, the 5th-6th take a -5 penalty, and the 7th-8th take a -10 penalty. Each Strike deals normal unarmed damage plus an additional 1d4 force damage (chakra-pathway disruption).

If at least 4 of the Strikes hit, the target loses 1 spell slot of their highest available rank (or, if no slots are available, becomes enfeebled 1 for 1 minute). If all 8 hit, they lose 2 slots and are enfeebled 1.
